messages:
elaine (AE): Hey team -- POC with WeaveHealth in APAC is hitting blockers. They pinned model to "rdx-large-v1" but requests from ap-southeast are returning 404/429 intermittently. They expect pinned behavior for consistency. Can someone help triage?

carlos (Sales-Eng): Noted. Do we have a sample request ID or logs from the customer? Also they asked about Dedicated trial pricing for a short eval.

elaine (AE): I have a couple sample request ids from their dev: req_8d92f and req_8d93b. Also they mentioned fallback to "rdx-large-quant-v1" producing noticeably different outputs. Pricing Q: they want a 2-week dedicated tryout estimate for 2 GPUs.

minh (SRE): digging into logs for those IDs now. quick checks: ap-southeast has limited copies of the full rdx-large-v1 (we keep quantized variants deployed more broadly). 1) 404 likely = model artifact not provisioned in that region. 2) 429s look like rate-limiter when SDK falls back to region routing.

sam (Platform-SE): @minh can you paste the error lines? Also is there an automatic fallback policy that swaps to quant variant? We need to know if pinning should prevent that.

minh (SRE): paste of customer side error snippet:

```
{"error":"model_not_found","message":"model rdx-large-v1 not available in ap-southeast-1"}
{"error":"rate_limit","code":429,"detail":"fallback-route exceeded qps"}
```

minh (SRE): So the platform is returning model_not_found upstream, then the SDK/fallback router tries an alternate endpoint causing transient 429s. Pinning currently means try to resolve that model id and fail — but our older client libs will try fallback-model routing.

carlos (Sales-Eng): Action items: 1) temporary workaround: route APAC traffic to eu-west for this POC (low latency tradeoff) or switch to rdx-large-quant-v1 and mark as expected deltas. 2) longer term: expand rdx-large-v1 replica to ap-southeast for enterprise POCs.

elaine (AE): Customer prefers not to route outside region for data residency reasons. Can we do a short-term dedicated allocation in APAC for this POC? Also need a written note for the security questionnaire about KMS and key custody.

jess (Security): For the questionnaire: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integration on Private/Dedicated. For Hosted, keys are managed by Redwood; we provide audit logs and can do BYOK on Private. I can draft the exact language.

minh (SRE): For dedicated trial in APAC: we can spin a 2-GPU reserved pool for 2 weeks, but it needs approvals from infra (capacity + cost). Pinged ops-bot for a quota check.

ops-bot: infra-quota-check: requested capacity check for "ap-southeast-1:2xA100". ETA: ~4h for manual approval.

sam (Platform-SE): Short-term tech workaround (if customer accepts): set request header `x-redwood-model-fallback: disabled` so SDK/router will error fast with model_not_found instead of auto routing. That keeps deterministic failures for the POC and avoids 429 noise. Example curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'x-redwood-model-fallback: disabled' \
  -d '{"model":"rdx-large-v1","input":"..."}'
```

carlos (Sales-Eng): Good call. Also for pricing estimate: rough Dedicated trial cost for 2 A100s in APAC for 2 weeks is $8k-$12k depending on networking. I'll draft a scoped quote and attach it to the deal.

elaine (AE): Please keep it tight — they want a one-page quote and the security blurb. Also need a checklist of steps for the SDRs if the customer decides to switch to quant variant.

jess (Security): I'll put together a short blurb: BYOK options, SOC2 scope, data-at-rest encryption, audit logs, and contact for compliance review.

minh (SRE): Next ops step: if quota approved, I'll trigger a short-lived deployment of rdx-large-v1 artifacts in ap-southeast and return when ready. ETA post-approval ~3h.

elaine (AE): Thanks all. I'll relay the fallback-header idea to the customer and ask if they can accept eu-west or want the dedicated trial. Keeping notes here for audit. :thumbsup:

carlos (Sales-Eng): tagging @sam and @minh for followups. I'll also prepare the quant-switch doc for the engineering contact at WeaveHealth with expected delta examples.

minh (SRE): update: infra approved quota. I'll start provisioning now and will post the deployment id when up.

ops-bot: deploy: started deployment dply-9a3b to ap-southeast-1 (rdx-large-v1). Logs at https://internal-logs/redwood/deploys/dply-9a3b

elaine (AE): amazing — thanks everyone. I'll keep the thread live until POC confirms.

carlos (Sales-Eng): thumbs up. if WeaveHealth needs corpus-level eval for output drift vs quant, we can run a differential eval; pricing for that is separate.

elaine (AE): noted. stopping here for now — will post customer acceptance or new errors.
